questions.prompt: Which property controls the direction of flex items in a flex container?
questions.explanation: flex-direction sets the main axis of the flex container, determining whether items flow horizontally or vertically.

questions.prompt: Which property defines the number and size of columns in a CSS grid container?
questions.explanation: grid-template-columns specifies track sizes for columns, creating the column structure of the grid.

questions.prompt: In the flex shorthand property flex: 1 1 auto, what does the first number represent?
questions.explanation: The first number in the flex shorthand is the flex-grow factor, determining how much a flex item can grow relative to others.

questions.prompt: What does the grid-auto-flow: dense rule do in CSS Grid?

options.text: Fills gaps by placing items in available space

questions.explanation: dense mode places items into gaps to reduce unused space, potentially changing the visual order.

questions.prompt: Which unit is relative to the font size of the root element?
questions.explanation: rem units scale relative to the root element’s font size, making them useful for responsive designs.

questions.prompt: How do you define a grid area that spans from column line 2 to line 5 and row line 1 to line 3 using the grid-area shorthand?
questions.explanation: grid-area uses the order row-start / column-start / row-end / column-end to position the area.
